decision: Reject the borrowed-fingerprint product change: Pyroscope CPU, RSS and query p99 have no consistent gain; CPU and query p99 ranges overlap and each is worse in two pairs. Loki RSS is higher in all three pairs. Tempo query p99 is lower in every pair, but its ranges overlap and one pair completes 235 baseline queries versus 236 candidate queries. Mimir RSS is lower in only two pairs. These mixed outcomes do not establish an efficiency advantage for the intended Pyroscope optimization. Correctness tests pass; diagnostic clone removal alone is not an end-to-end gain.
